subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar first land the narrow fork-identity/cache repair and remeasure, or commit to the four-PR lineage accounting architecture as the canonical long-term solution?
rationale: Both paths have positive real-world proof and overlap the same accounting failure, but they differ substantially in scope, compatibility surface, and long-term maintenance cost; code review cannot choose that product and architecture direction safely.

options.title: Land narrow repair first
options.body: Merge and validate https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118, then reassess whether the remaining error justifies the lineage stack.

options.title: Sponsor the lineage stack
options.body: Approve the lineage architecture and merge https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order with legacy remaining the default.

options.title: Keep legacy containment
options.body: Decline both architectural expansions for now and continue improving the existing scanner through smaller targeted fixes.

recommendation.title: Land narrow repair first
recommendation.body: Merge and validate https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118, then reassess whether the remaining error justifies the lineage stack.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice determines CodexBar's canonical accounting architecture and upgrade contract.
